questions.ask: What name should I use for you: the one that appears on screen and in my notes?
What is the business or brand called?
What is your main handle, and on which platform do you post most?
In one sentence: what do you help people with, and who are they?
What is your accent colour (the one colour used for the title keyword, arrows and highlights)?
(the plain word for the accent colour)
Which font do you use for headlines?
(found on their computer) the bold weight of the main font
(found on their computer) the regular weight of the main font, used for every paragraph; a system font saved as local if the main font has no readable regular weight
Do you want the big title in a different font from your headings (for example a serif)? Left unset, it is the main font.
(found on their computer) the title font; left unset, the main bold is used
Do you want the title keyword in a second, contrasting font, or the same font in your colour?
(found on their computer) the emphasis font; the shipped Playfair Display Italic if they have no preference
Where do you keep the real things I can show on screen: client results, reviews, screenshots?
What are the two or three real results that go in the 'why you should listen to me' section? Facts in your own words; I never add to them.
What should the small line above the title say: your series, channel or programme name?
Do you have your own framework images, models or diagrams? Where do they live?
Which two kinds of people watch you (for the section that gives the same advice for each)?
